d:
Jab divali aati hai, to mithaiyon ke sath mitti ke diye bhi khub bikte dikhte hain. divali manane ke lie diye jalane ka yah rivaz sadiyon purana hai, aur mitti ke diye banane ki paranprik kala bhi. lekin gujrat men diye banane vale kumhar ab is bat se pareshan hain ki unki agli pirhi yah kala nahin sikhegi. is dar ke pichhe kya vajah hai? dekhiye yah vidiyo.
Riport: shyam bakshi
